definitions.explanation: In most cases or instances; describing what normally happens or is true.

examples.japanese: たいてい⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きます→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I usually wake up at seven o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たいてい⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm usually at home on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たいてい⟦{混|こ}んでいます→混む：02574_komu⟧。

⟦{朝|あさ}ごはん→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たいてい⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: For breakfast, I usually eat bread and eggs and drink coffee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たいてい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He can usually solve most problems himself, but this time he needed help.
examples.notes: たいていの + noun = most/majority of

notes:
たいてい means "usually" or "in most cases," implying a high frequency with room for exceptions. Can be written as {大抵|たいてい} in kanji, but hiragana is far more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As an adverb: たいてい + verb (usually does something)
- As a pre-noun modifier: たいていの + noun (most/the majority of)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (stronger — implies no exceptions)
- たいてい: usually (most of the time, but exceptions exist)
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: usually/normally (focuses on what is standard or typical)
- ⟦{大体|だいたい}→だいたい：00831_daitai⟧: roughly, mostly (more approximate; also used for estimates)

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically placed before the verb phrase: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧はたいてい⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧に⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。Sentence-initial position is also natural.
